<!-- perf-trend:dev:shell -->
The scheduled performance trend of `dev` measured **shell** past its thresholds at two consecutive points.

| Cell | Before | After | Ratio |
|---|---|---|---|
| shell/x10/webkit/desktop/away/cpu_ms | 1810 | 5920 | 3.27x |

Commits from the last good point `ff2c66b8226d` to the first bad point `e0d01e98bc21`: https://github.com/cplieger/marotte/compare/ff2c66b8226d7675622af139bdb4d1599e0e2b81...e0d01e98bc218329f951bcd1af65583e8903640d

Runs of the bad points:

- https://github.com/cplieger/marotte/actions/runs/45147078936
- https://github.com/cplieger/marotte/actions/runs/45226756370

Counts that changed: `shell/x1/chromium/desktop/back/dom` 8902 to 10298, `shell/x1/chromium/phone/back/dom` 9312 to 8959, `shell/x1/webkit/phone/back/dom` 4766 to 4992, `shell/x10/chromium/desktop/back/dom` 11959 to 11866, `shell/x10/chromium/desktop/cold/reads:GET /api/chats` 2 to 1, `shell/x10/chromium/phone/back/dom` 9361 to 9243, `shell/x10/webkit/desktop/back/dom` 9671 to 11810, `shell/x10/webkit/phone/back/dom` 9338 to 9362.

Before is the cell's baseline, the median of up to 7 earlier good points; After is the latest point. A cell is bad at cpu_ms over 2.0x and more than 250 ms over, server_cpu_ms over 2.0x and more than 10 ms over, heap_mb over 1.25x and more than 2 MB over, rss_mb over 1.25x and more than 50 MB over. This issue closes itself after two consecutive good points; closing it by hand accepts the new values as the baseline.
